village.name: Village Square
village.description: A bustling market square filled with vendors and townsfolk.

tower.name: Ancient Tower
tower.description: An imposing tower with a locked door. Inside is a mysterious relic that needs to be retrieved.
tower.image_prompt: dark stone tower gates, fantasy art

ancient_trethere.name: Ancient Temple
ancient_trethere.description: A dimly lit temple filled with ancient relics and traps.
ancient_trethere.image_prompt: ancient tomb in a ruined city, fantasy art

relic.name: Divine Relic
relic.description: A mystical artifact said to have the power to grant great wisdom and knowledge.

hero.name: Alden
hero.description: A brave apprentice searcher of lost relics.

relic_guardian.name: The Relic Guardian
relic_guardian.description: An ancient entity that watches over the relic and will stop at nothing to protect it.
relic_guardian.image_prompt: ancient statue guarding a mysterious artifact, fantasy art

dialogues.before_talk: Guardian: Intruder! You dare enter my sacred temple?
dialogues.after_talk: Guardian: Stay still... let me show you the true power of the Divine Relic.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Guardian: Now, go forth with wisdom and knowledge.
dialogues.hostile: Guardian: Do not approach! You have trespassed!
